steps.text:
I've built the football scoreboard. It passes validation with no errors or warnings, and the record is handed in at `/mnt/session/outputs/record.json` (with `record.zip` beside it). I looked through every frame in the coverage set (`/mnt/session/outputs/coverage`) and nothing needed fixing. Nothing was saved to NoaCG from here.

**How it looks:** a single bar in the top-left corner, inside the safe area and clear of the pitch: `HOME | 0 – 0 | AWAY`. Each team has its own colour strip at the outer edge, and the two scores sit in a yellow block in the middle.
- **Goal:** a yellow tab slides down under the bar reading "● GOAL HOME", with a dot in the scoring team's colour. That team's side of the bar pulses in its colour and keeps a soft glow until the operator clears it. A second goal plays the moment again; a goal for the other side switches the tab over.
- **Full time:** the score block turns white, a white "FULL TIME" tab slides out, and the losing team's name dims. A draw dims neither name. Pressing Full time also clears any goal tab.
- **Long school names:** the text gets smaller to fit and is never cut off. I tested "ST. MARY'S 2–1 KINGSWOOD ACADEMY".
